note: What each company does, in our own words, from its latest annual report (SEC 10-K / 20-F / 40-F, or the company's own annual report for non-SEC filers). Industry = SEC SIC description; HQ = SEC business address. Facts only; not financial advice.

AAPL.name: Apple Inc
AAPL.whatTheyDo: Apple designs, makes and sells iPhone smartphones, Mac computers, iPad tablets, wearables such as Apple Watch and AirPods, and home devices and accessories. It also sells related services, including advertising.

ABNB.name: Airbnb, Inc.
ABNB.whatTheyDo: Airbnb runs an online marketplace where hosts offer guests places to stay, plus experiences and services, across more than 220 countries and regions.

ADBE.name: Adobe Inc.
ADBE.whatTheyDo: Adobe sells software for making and editing content, including Creative Cloud apps like Photoshop and Premiere Pro and Acrobat for documents, plus marketing tools built on Adobe Experience Platform.

ALLY.name: Ally Finl Inc
ALLY.whatTheyDo: Ally Financial runs an all-digital bank offering deposits, brokerage and investment advice, plus auto financing and insurance. It also provides capital to equity sponsors and middle-market companies.

AMD.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
AMD.sourceName: ADVANCED MICRO DEVICES INC annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-04)
AMD.whatTheyDo: AMD designs chips for computing and AI, including CPUs, GPUs, AI accelerators, networking products and FPGAs. Its products are used in data centers, PCs, gaming and embedded systems.

AMX.name: América Móvil
AMX.sourceName: AMERICA MOVIL SAB DE CV/ annual report (20-F) (filed 2026-04-28)
AMX.whatTheyDo: América Móvil provides mobile, fixed-line, broadband and pay TV services in 23 countries. Mexico and Brazil are its main operations, and it also operates in seven Central and Eastern European countries.

AMZN.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
AMZN.whatTheyDo: Amazon sells goods through its online and physical stores, makes devices like Kindle, Echo and Ring, and runs the Prime membership. Its AWS unit rents computing, storage and AI services to businesses.

AN.name: AutoNation
AN.whatTheyDo: AutoNation runs car dealerships across the U.S., mostly in Sunbelt cities, selling new and used vehicles, repair and parts services, collision repair, and vehicle financing and protection products.

ANET.name: Arista Networks, Inc.
ANET.whatTheyDo: Arista Networks sells Ethernet networking products and software, built on its EOS operating system, that connect AI, data center, campus and wide-area networks for cloud, AI and enterprise customers.

ARM.name: Arm Holdings plc
ARM.whatTheyDo: Arm designs and licenses CPU designs that other firms build into chips for phones, PCs, cars and data centers. In March 2026 it unveiled its own chip, the Arm AGI CPU, which it expects to start producing by late 2026.

AVGO.name: Broadcom Inc.
AVGO.whatTheyDo: Broadcom makes chips and chip-based hardware such as networking components used in data centers, broadband, wireless and storage gear. It also sells infrastructure software, including VMware Cloud Foundation.

AXP.name: American Express Co
AXP.whatTheyDo: American Express issues credit and charge cards, runs its own card network, and processes card payments for merchants. It also offers deposits, loans, and travel and expense services to consumers and businesses.

BABA.name: Alibaba Group
BABA.sourceName: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd annual report (20-F) (filed 2026-05-20)
BABA.whatTheyDo: Alibaba runs online shopping platforms in China such as Taobao and Tmall, international marketplaces like AliExpress, Trendyol and Lazada, and a cloud computing and AI business.

BAC.name: Bank Of Amer Corp
BAC.sourceName: BANK OF AMERICA CORP /DE/ annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-25)
BAC.whatTheyDo: Bank of America offers banking, investing, asset management and risk management products. It serves consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, large companies, institutional investors and governments.

BAER.name: Bridger Aerospace Group
BAER.sourceName: Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-03-06)
BAER.whatTheyDo: Bridger Aerospace flies aircraft to fight and watch wildfires, mainly in the United States. It also modifies and fits out aircraft for government and commercial customers.

BCH.name: Banco de Chile
BCH.whatTheyDo: Banco de Chile offers loans and other banking services to all kinds of customers in Chile. Its subsidiaries add securities brokerage, mutual funds, investment banking, insurance brokerage and card processing.

BNC.name: CEA Industries Inc.
BNC.whatTheyDo: CEA Industries holds BNB, the token of the BNB Chain, as its main asset to give stock investors exposure to it. It also runs a smaller retail vape business in Canada.

BRK.B.name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
BRK.B.whatTheyDo: Berkshire Hathaway is a holding company whose subsidiaries mainly sell insurance and reinsurance, run a freight railroad and own utility and energy businesses, plus many manufacturing, service and retail firms.

BX.name: Blackstone Inc.
BX.whatTheyDo: Blackstone is an alternative asset manager that invests money for pension funds, insurers and individuals. Its strategies span real estate, private equity, infrastructure, credit, secondaries and hedge funds.

C.name: Citigroup Inc.
C.whatTheyDo: Citigroup is a financial services holding company serving consumers, companies, governments and institutions with consumer banking and credit, investment banking, brokerage and wealth management in nearly 160 countries.

CARL.name: Carlsmed, Inc.
CARL.whatTheyDo: Carlsmed is a medical technology company that uses AI to plan spine fusion surgeries for each patient. It sells kits with custom-fit spinal implants and single-use instruments for lumbar and cervical fusion.

CAT.name: Caterpillar
CAT.whatTheyDo: Caterpillar builds construction and mining machines, off-highway engines, gas turbines for industry and diesel-electric locomotives. It sells through a global network of dealers and lends to buyers via Cat Financial.

CCU.name: Compañía Cervecerías Unidas
CCU.sourceName: UNITED BREWERIES CO INC annual report (20-F) (filed 2026-04-29)
CCU.whatTheyDo: CCU is a Chilean drinks company that makes and sells beer, soft drinks, bottled water, juice, wine, cider and spirits in Chile, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Paraguay and Uruguay.

CEG.name: Constellation Energy
CEG.whatTheyDo: Constellation Energy generates power in the U.S. from nuclear, gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar plants. It also sells electricity and gas to about 2.5 million retail customer accounts nationwide.

CELH.name: Celsius Holdings
CELH.industry: Bottled & Canned Soft Drinks & Carbonated Waters
CELH.whatTheyDo: Celsius sells energy drinks under its CELSIUS, Alani Nu and Rockstar brands, plus some wellness products. They are sold in grocery and convenience stores, fitness centers and online in the U.S. and other regions.

CHYM.name: Chime Financial, Inc.
CHYM.whatTheyDo: Chime, a technology company rather than a bank, offers banking products through FDIC-insured partner banks in its mobile app. They help everyday Americans spend, save, get short-term cash and build credit.

CMP.name: Compass Minerals International
CMP.industry: Mining & Quarrying of  Nonmetallic Minerals (No Fuels)
CMP.sourceName: COMPASS MINERALS INTERNATIONAL INC annual report (10-K) (filed 2025-12-12)
CMP.whatTheyDo: Compass Minerals produces salt and plant nutrition products such as sulfate of potash fertilizer, from sites in the U.S., Canada and the UK. It also offers records management services in the UK.

CMTG.name: Claros Mortgage Trust
CMTG.sourceName: Claros Mortgage Trust, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-18)
CMTG.whatTheyDo: Claros Mortgage Trust is a commercial real estate lender that makes senior and mezzanine loans on properties being renovated, leased up or redeveloped in major U.S. markets.

CNI.name: Canadian National Railway
CNI.sourceName: CANADIAN NATIONAL RAILWAY CO annual report (40-F) (filed 2026-02-04)
CNI.whatTheyDo: Canadian National (CN) is a freight railroad with a network of nearly 20,000 miles linking Canada's east and west coasts to the American Midwest and Gulf Coast. It hauls natural resources and manufactured goods.

COAG.name: Hemab Therapeutics Holdings
COAG.sourceName: Hemab Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. IPO prospectus (424B4) (filed 2026-05-01)
COAG.whatTheyDo: Hemab Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech company developing treatments for bleeding and blood-clotting disorders. Its lead candidate, sutacimig, is in trials for Glanzmann thrombasthenia and Factor VII deficiency.

COF.name: Capital One Finl Corp
COF.sourceName: CAPITAL ONE FINANCIAL CORP annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-19)
COF.whatTheyDo: Capital One is a U.S. bank that issues credit cards and, since buying Discover in 2025, also runs the Discover and PULSE payment networks. It offers debit cards, auto loans, deposits and business banking too.

CRBG.name: Corebridge Financial
CRBG.whatTheyDo: Corebridge Financial sells retirement and insurance products in the United States. It has four businesses: Individual Retirement, Group Retirement, Life Insurance and Institutional Markets.

CRM.name: Salesforce, Inc.
CRM.whatTheyDo: Salesforce sells customer relationship management software, mostly by subscription, covering sales, service, marketing, commerce and data. Its Agentforce product lets businesses deploy AI agents.

CVE.name: Cenovus Energy Inc.
CVE.whatTheyDo: Cenovus is a Calgary-based energy company that produces oil and natural gas, including Alberta oil sands, and refines and upgrades crude into fuels at plants in Canada and the U.S.

CVX.name: Chevron Corporation
CVX.whatTheyDo: Chevron explores for, produces and transports crude oil and natural gas, including LNG. It also refines oil into fuels and lubricants, makes renewable fuels and petrochemicals, and markets these products.

DAL.name: Delta Air Lines Inc
DAL.sourceName: DELTA AIR LINES, INC. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-11)
DAL.whatTheyDo: Delta Air Lines is a U.S.-based airline flying passengers on a global network. It also runs the SkyMiles loyalty program, an aircraft maintenance business, cargo operations and Delta Vacations.

DAO.name: Youdao, Inc.
DAO.whatTheyDo: Youdao is a Chinese company offering learning apps and online courses, AI-powered subscriptions, online ad services, and smart learning devices such as dictionary pens. Its flagship app is Youdao Dictionary.

DE.name: Deere & Co.
DE.whatTheyDo: Deere, known as John Deere, makes farm equipment for large and small growers, turf and utility machines, and construction, roadbuilding and forestry equipment. It also finances purchases made through its dealers.

DELL.name: Dell Technologies Inc.
DELL.whatTheyDo: Dell Technologies sells PCs and other client devices and peripherals, along with servers, networking and storage equipment for businesses, plus related services, in over 170 countries.

DHI.name: D R Horton Inc
DHI.sourceName: HORTON D R INC /DE/ annual report (10-K) (filed 2025-11-19)
DHI.whatTheyDo: D.R. Horton builds and sells homes in 36 states, mostly single-family detached, with offerings from entry-level to luxury and homes for active adults. It also has rental, lot development and financial services units.

DOCN.name: DigitalOcean Holdings, Inc.
DOCN.whatTheyDo: DigitalOcean runs a cloud platform offering virtual servers, storage, managed databases and GPU capacity for AI work. Its customers include growing tech companies in fields like gaming, fintech and cybersecurity.

DVA.name: Davita Inc
DVA.whatTheyDo: DaVita provides kidney care, including dialysis for patients with kidney failure. It treats patients at home, in its dialysis centers, in hospitals and in skilled nursing facilities.

ECL.name: Ecolab
ECL.industry: Soap, Detergents, Cleang Preparations, Perfumes, Cosmetics
ECL.whatTheyDo: Ecolab sells water treatment, cleaning, sanitizing and infection prevention products and services to industries such as food, healthcare and hospitality. It also offers pest elimination services.

FANG.name: Diamondback Energy, Inc.
FANG.whatTheyDo: Diamondback Energy is an oil and natural gas producer that acquires and drills onshore shale reserves, mainly in the Permian Basin of West Texas and New Mexico.

FMX.name: FEMSA
FMX.industry: Bottled & Canned Soft Drinks & Carbonated Waters
FMX.sourceName: MEXICAN ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT INC annual report (20-F) (filed 2026-04-24)
FMX.whatTheyDo: FEMSA holds a controlling stake in Coca-Cola bottler Coca-Cola FEMSA and runs OXXO small-format stores across the Americas, convenience stores in Europe, OXXO Gas stations, pharmacies and Spin, a digital finance unit.

FRCOY.name: Fast Retailing
FRCOY.sourceName: Fast Retailing: Overview of Business Segments
FRCOY.whatTheyDo: Fast Retailing runs clothing store chains, mainly UNIQLO in Japan and abroad, plus GU and global brands including Theory, PLST and Comptoir des Cotonniers.

GETY.name: Getty Images Holdings
GETY.sourceName: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-03-16)
GETY.whatTheyDo: Getty Images licenses creative and editorial photos, video and music, including news, sports and entertainment coverage, to businesses, media companies and creators. It also offers generative AI tools for making images.

GM.name: General Motors Company
GM.whatTheyDo: GM makes and sells cars, trucks, crossovers and parts under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet and GMC brands, along with software-based services and subscriptions. Its GM Financial arm provides auto financing.

GOLD.name: Gold.com, Inc.
GOLD.whatTheyDo: Gold.com trades gold, silver, platinum and palladium bullion and coins wholesale and sells them directly to consumers. It also runs mints, storage and logistics, and makes loans backed by bullion and coins.

GOOGL.name: Alphabet Inc.
GOOGL.whatTheyDo: Alphabet owns Google, whose products include Search, YouTube, Android, Chrome, Gmail, Maps, Gemini and advertising, plus Google Cloud for businesses; other units include Waymo.

GS.name: Goldman Sachs Group
GS.sourceName: GOLDMAN SACHS GROUP INC annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-25)
GS.whatTheyDo: Goldman Sachs provides investment banking, trading and financing, lending, and asset and wealth management. Its clients include corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

GUTS.name: Fractyl Health, Inc.
GUTS.whatTheyDo: Fractyl Health is a clinical-stage company developing treatments for obesity and type 2 diabetes. Its candidates are Revita, a procedure that resurfaces the lining of the small intestine, and Rejuva gene therapies.

HAYW.name: Hayward Holdings
HAYW.whatTheyDo: Hayward designs and makes swimming pool equipment, plus outdoor living and industrial flow control products. It estimates about 85% of sales come from repairing, replacing or upgrading gear at existing pools.

HBM.name: Hudbay Minerals
HBM.whatTheyDo: Hudbay Minerals mines mainly copper, plus gold, zinc, silver and molybdenum, at mines in Peru and Canada. It is developing new copper projects in Arizona, Nevada and Peru.

HCA.name: HCA Healthcare, Inc.
HCA.whatTheyDo: HCA Healthcare runs hospitals, surgery centers and other outpatient sites in 19 U.S. states and England, providing acute care, surgery, emergency, behavioral and rehabilitation services.

IBKR.name: Interactive Brokers Group
IBKR.sourceName: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-27)
IBKR.whatTheyDo: Interactive Brokers is an automated online broker that lets individuals, funds and advisors trade stocks, options, futures, currencies, bonds and funds on exchanges in about 40 countries.

IBTA.name: Ibotta Inc
IBTA.whatTheyDo: Ibotta delivers digital promotions, mostly from consumer packaged goods brands, to shoppers through partners such as Walmart and Instacart and through its own cash back app, website and browser extension.

ICL.name: ICL Group Ltd.
ICL.whatTheyDo: ICL Group extracts potash and bromine from the Dead Sea and mines phosphate in Israel and China, turning these minerals into fertilizers, food ingredients and industrial chemicals for customers worldwide.

IDEXY.name: Inditex
IDEXY.whatTheyDo: Inditex is a fashion group whose brands are Zara, Pull&Bear, Massimo Dutti, Bershka, Stradivarius, Oysho, Zara Home and Lefties. It reports a presence in 214 markets.

INTC.name: Intel Corp.
INTC.whatTheyDo: Intel designs and makes CPUs and other semiconductor products, mostly in its own factories, many in the U.S. It sells to computer and device makers and cloud providers, and makes chips for other companies as a foundry.

INTR.name: Inter & Co
INTR.whatTheyDo: Inter&Co runs a digital bank and super app in Brazil offering accounts, payments, loans, investments, insurance brokerage and online shopping. It also serves Brazilians traveling abroad or living in the US.

JEF.name: Jefferies Financial Group In
JEF.sourceName: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-01-28)
JEF.whatTheyDo: Jefferies is a New York-based investment bank that advises companies, raises capital and trades securities for clients, and also runs credit and alternative asset management businesses.

JMKE.name: Jersey Mike's Subs Inc.
JMKE.sourceName: Jersey Mike's Subs Inc. IPO prospectus (424B4) (filed 2026-07-31)
JMKE.whatTheyDo: Jersey Mike's franchises fast-casual restaurants that make submarine sandwiches, with stores in all 50 U.S. states; nearly all of its stores are run by franchise owners.

JPM.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
JPM.whatTheyDo: JPMorganChase offers investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, payment processing and asset management. Its customers are mostly in the U.S., plus big institutional clients worldwide.

KBDC.name: Kayne Anderson BDC
KBDC.sourceName: Kayne Anderson BDC, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-03-02)
KBDC.whatTheyDo: Kayne Anderson BDC is a business development company that lends to private middle-market companies, mainly through first lien senior secured loans. It is managed by an affiliate of Kayne Anderson.

KEN.name: Kenon Holdings Ltd.
KEN.whatTheyDo: Kenon is a holding company whose main business is a roughly 46% stake in OPC Energy. OPC owns, develops and operates power plants in Israel and the United States.

KHC.name: Kraft Heinz Co
KHC.industry: Canned, Frozen & Preservd Fruit, Veg & Food Specialties
KHC.whatTheyDo: Kraft Heinz makes and sells packaged foods and drinks worldwide, including condiments and sauces, mac and cheese, snacks, desserts, cheese, coffee and meats, through grocery, club and foodservice channels.

KLAR.name: Klarna Group plc
KLAR.whatTheyDo: Klarna is a Swedish-founded digital bank and payments company that lets shoppers pay for purchases over time, mostly interest-free, and also sells advertising, in 26 countries.

KO.name: Coca Cola Co
KO.whatTheyDo: Coca-Cola owns or licenses and markets drink brands such as Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta and Diet Coke, plus water, sports drinks, coffee, tea and juice, sold in over 200 countries largely via bottling partners.

KR.name: Kroger Co
KR.whatTheyDo: Kroger runs grocery stores, many with pharmacies and fuel centers, and sells groceries online. It also earns money from media and advertising built on its store and customer data.

LEN.name: Lennar Corp
LEN.whatTheyDo: Lennar builds and sells homes in many American states. It also makes mortgage loans, offers title insurance and closing services, and develops apartment buildings for rent.

LLYVA.name: Liberty Live Holdings Inc
LLYVA.sourceName: Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-26)
LLYVA.whatTheyDo: Liberty Live is a holding company that owns a large stake in concert and ticketing company Live Nation and owns Quint, which sells official ticket-inclusive hospitality packages for sports and live events.

LLYVK.name: Liberty Live Holdings Inc
LLYVK.sourceName: Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-26)
LLYVK.whatTheyDo: Liberty Live is a holding company that owns a stake in Live Nation, the concert promoter and Ticketmaster owner, and owns Quint, which sells premium hospitality packages for sports and entertainment events.

LPX.name: Louisiana Pac Corp
LPX.whatTheyDo: Louisiana-Pacific (LP) makes building products, mainly engineered wood siding and oriented strand board (OSB), for new homes, remodeling and outdoor structures. Its main customers are in North and South America.

LRLCY.name: L'Oréal
LRLCY.whatTheyDo: L'Oréal sells beauty products through four divisions, Consumer Products, Luxe, Dermatological Beauty and Professional Products, which together hold about 40 brands.

LTH.name: Life Time Group Holdings
LTH.sourceName: Life Time Group Holdings, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-24)
LTH.whatTheyDo: Life Time runs membership-based athletic clubs with gyms, pools, courts, spas, cafés and childcare. It has more than 185 centers across the United States and in one Canadian province.

LVMUY.name: LVMH
LVMUY.whatTheyDo: LVMH is home to more than 75 brands across six sectors, including wines and spirits, fashion and leather goods, perfumes and cosmetics, watches and jewelry, and retailers such as Sephora and Le Bon Marché.

LVS.name: Las Vegas Sands Corp.
LVS.sourceName: LAS VEGAS SANDS CORP annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-06)
LVS.whatTheyDo: Las Vegas Sands develops and runs large resorts that combine casinos, hotels, shopping malls, convention space and restaurants. It owns and operates these resorts in Macao and Singapore.

LYB.name: LyondellBasell Industries N.V.
LYB.whatTheyDo: LyondellBasell turns oil- and gas-based feedstocks into plastic resins and other chemicals used in packaging, furnishings, car parts and paints. It also licenses process technology and sells catalysts.

M.name: Macys Inc
M.whatTheyDo: Macy's, Inc. runs stores, websites and mobile apps under its Macy's, Bloomingdale's and Bluemercury brands, selling apparel, accessories, beauty products, home furnishings and other merchandise.

MCO.name: Moodys Corp
MCO.whatTheyDo: Moody's issues credit ratings, research and risk analysis through Moody's Investors Service, and sells data, analytics and decision tools through Moody's Analytics to banks, insurers, investors and companies.

MDLN.name: Medline Inc.
MDLN.whatTheyDo: Medline makes and distributes medical-surgical supplies such as surgical kits, gloves, wound care and lab products. It serves hospitals, surgery centers, doctors' offices and post-acute care facilities.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.whatTheyDo: Meta runs Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp, earning almost all its revenue from ads. Its Reality Labs unit makes hardware such as Meta Quest headsets and AI glasses.

MP.name: MP Materials
MP.sourceName: MP Materials Corp. / DE annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-26)
MP.whatTheyDo: MP Materials mines and refines rare earths at Mountain Pass, California, selling oxides and metals mainly to Asian buyers. A Fort Worth, Texas plant makes metal, alloy and permanent magnets.

MRVL.name: Marvell Technology
MRVL.whatTheyDo: Marvell designs chips for data infrastructure, used mainly in data centers and communications networks, and has them manufactured by others.

MSFT.name: Microsoft
MSFT.whatTheyDo: Microsoft develops software, cloud and AI services, operating systems, business apps and video games, and sells devices such as PCs, tablets and gaming consoles. It also sells online advertising.

MT.name: ArcelorMittal S.A.
MT.industry: Steel Works, Blast Furnaces & Rolling Mills (Coke Ovens)
MT.whatTheyDo: ArcelorMittal makes steel and mines iron ore, with steel plants in 14 countries. It sells sheet, plate, bars, rods, pipes and other steel products to automotive, construction, appliance and machinery customers.

MXF.name: The Mexico Fund
MXF.sourceName: MEXICO FUND INC annual shareholder report (N-CSR) (filed 2025-12-29)
MXF.whatTheyDo: The Mexico Fund is a closed-end investment fund that aims for long-term growth by investing mainly in shares listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange.

NMAX.name: Newsmax Inc. Class B common
NMAX.whatTheyDo: Newsmax produces news and opinion programming for its TV channels, website, radio show, podcasts and publications. It earns money from advertising, fees paid by TV distributors, and paid digital and print subscriptions.

NTES.name: NetEase, Inc.
NTES.whatTheyDo: NetEase offers more than 100 online games, built in-house or licensed. It also runs Youdao learning services and devices, NetEase Cloud Music, Yanxuan e-commerce, advertising, e-mail and payments, mainly in China.

NUE.name: Nucor Corp
NUE.industry: Steel Works, Blast Furnaces & Rolling Mills (Coke Ovens)
NUE.whatTheyDo: Nucor makes steel and steel products, mostly in North America, using recycled scrap steel as its main raw material, and also produces raw materials for its mills.

NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.whatTheyDo: NVIDIA offers GPUs, networking and data center systems plus its CUDA software platform. They are used for heavy computing such as AI model training and inference, data analysis, science, robotics and 3D graphics.

NVR.name: Nvr Inc
NVR.whatTheyDo: NVR builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes and condos under the Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes names. It also offers mortgage and title services to its homebuyers.

NXE.name: NexGen Energy Ltd.
NXE.whatTheyDo: NexGen Energy is developing its Rook I uranium project, home to the Arrow Deposit, in the Athabasca Basin of Saskatchewan, Canada. It also owns other uranium exploration properties in that area.

NYT.name: New York Times Co Mtn Be
NYT.sourceName: NEW YORK TIMES CO annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-27)
NYT.whatTheyDo: The New York Times Company publishes The Times in print, online and in apps, plus The Athletic, Cooking, Games, Audio and Wirecutter. It earns money mainly from subscriptions and advertising.

OGN.name: Organon & Co.
OGN.whatTheyDo: Organon sells prescription medicines, focused on women's health such as contraception and fertility, plus general medicines and biosimilars, in over 140 countries.

OKUR.name: OnKure Therapeutics
OKUR.whatTheyDo: OnKure Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech developing small molecule drugs that target specific disease-causing mutations in cancer. Its lead candidate, OKI-219, targets a mutated form of PI3Kα.

OPEN.name: Opendoor Technologies
OPEN.whatTheyDo: Opendoor runs an online platform that buys homes directly from owners and resells them, letting people buy and sell homes digitally. It operates in the United States.

ORCL.name: Oracle Corporation
ORCL.whatTheyDo: Oracle sells business software applications and IT infrastructure, including databases and cloud services. Customers can run them in Oracle's cloud, on their own premises, or in a mix.

OXY.name: Occidental Pete Corp
OXY.whatTheyDo: Occidental Petroleum produces oil and gas, mainly in the Permian and DJ Basins, the offshore Gulf of America and Oman, plus elsewhere in the Middle East and North Africa. It also runs midstream and carbon capture units.

PBF.name: PBF Energy Inc. Class A
PBF.whatTheyDo: PBF Energy owns six U.S. oil refineries that turn crude into gasoline, diesel, heating oil and other fuels and petroleum products, and runs related pipelines, terminals and storage.

PDD.name: PDD Holdings Inc.
PDD.whatTheyDo: PDD Holdings runs online marketplaces where third-party merchants sell to shoppers: Pinduoduo, known for group 'team purchase' pricing, and Temu, which serves buyers in the U.S., Europe, Japan and elsewhere.

PJT.name: PJT Partners
PJT.whatTheyDo: PJT Partners is an investment bank focused on advice. It counsels companies and investors on mergers, restructurings, shareholder matters and raising capital.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.whatTheyDo: Palantir builds software that helps governments and companies combine and analyze their data and run operations. Its platforms are Gotham for defense and intelligence, Foundry, Apollo and its AI Platform.

PPRUY.name: Kering
PPRUY.whatTheyDo: Kering is a luxury group whose houses, including Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga and Boucheron, make clothing, leather goods, jewelry, eyewear and beauty products.

PSKY.name: Paramount Skydance Corp.
PSKY.whatTheyDo: Paramount Skydance is a media company that owns TV networks including CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV and BET, the Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming services, and the Paramount Pictures film studio.

RCL.name: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd.
RCL.sourceName: ROYAL CARIBBEAN CRUISES LTD annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-11)
RCL.whatTheyDo: Royal Caribbean operates cruise lines including Royal Caribbean, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea, sailing to destinations worldwide, and also owns private island and beach club destinations.

RDDT.name: Reddit, Inc.
RDDT.whatTheyDo: Reddit runs an online platform of more than 100,000 active communities, called subreddits, where people post links, images and videos, ask questions and discuss topics in comment threads.

RSG.name: Republic Services
RSG.whatTheyDo: Republic Services collects, recycles and disposes of trash and other waste across the United States and Canada. It runs collection operations, transfer stations, recycling centers and landfills.

RUM.name: Rumble Inc.
RUM.whatTheyDo: Rumble runs a video-sharing platform for creators, plus an advertising marketplace and a crypto wallet for tipping creators. It also sells cloud computing and storage services to businesses through Rumble Cloud.

SAFE.name: Safehold Inc.
SAFE.whatTheyDo: Safehold buys and manages ground leases: it owns the land under commercial real estate projects and leases it long term, often 30 to 99 years, to the owners of the buildings on it.

SCCO.name: Southern Copper Corporation
SCCO.whatTheyDo: Southern Copper mines, smelts and refines copper, along with molybdenum, zinc and silver, at operations in Peru and Mexico.

SFTBY.name: SoftBank Group
SFTBY.sourceName: SoftBank Group: Net Asset Value per Share
SFTBY.whatTheyDo: SoftBank Group reports its net asset value as its holdings minus net debt. As of June 30, 2026, those holdings were led by Arm, then the SoftBank Vision Funds, SoftBank Corp. and its Latin America Funds.

SHOP.name: Shopify Inc.
SHOP.whatTheyDo: Shopify offers a commerce platform that lets merchants sell online, in stores, on social media and AI platforms, and manage inventory and transactions. Its merchants come from more than 175 countries.

SIRI.name: Siriusxm Holdings Inc
SIRI.sourceName: SIRIUS XM HOLDINGS INC. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-02-05)
SIRI.whatTheyDo: Sirius XM offers SiriusXM, a paid subscription service of music, sports, talk and news channels, plus the Pandora music streaming service and podcasts. It earns money from subscriptions and advertising.

SLI.name: Standard Lithium
SLI.whatTheyDo: Standard Lithium is developing projects to extract lithium from underground brine in southern Arkansas and East Texas, working with Equinor. It has not yet reached commercial production.

SPCX.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp.
SPCX.sourceName: SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP IPO prospectus (424B4) (filed 2026-06-12)
SPCX.whatTheyDo: SpaceX designs, builds and launches rockets and spacecraft that carry astronauts, satellites and other cargo. It also runs the Starlink satellite internet network and, since buying xAI in 2026, the Grok AI models.

SPOT.name: Spotify Technology S.A.
SPOT.whatTheyDo: Spotify runs an audio streaming service offering music, podcasts and audiobooks in 184 countries and territories, through both paid Premium subscriptions and a free tier supported by ads.

STGW.name: Stagwell Inc. Class A
STGW.whatTheyDo: Stagwell is a network of marketing agencies offering creative, digital transformation, media and commerce, and communications services to brands, plus marketing software and data tools.

SYM.name: Symbotic Inc.
SYM.whatTheyDo: Symbotic makes robotic warehouse automation systems, combining hardware and AI-powered software, that move, store and sort cases and individual items. Customers include Walmart and wholesale distributors.

TALO.name: Talos Energy Inc.
TALO.whatTheyDo: Talos Energy explores for and produces oil and natural gas offshore in the U.S. Gulf of America. It also holds an indirect stake in the Zama oil field off Mexico, which has not yet started production.

TCEHY.name: Tencent
TCEHY.whatTheyDo: Tencent makes internet products and services, including the Weixin/WeChat messaging app and Tencent Games, and sells cloud computing and marketing services to businesses.

TECK.name: Teck Resources Class B
TECK.industry: Mining & Quarrying of  Nonmetallic Minerals (No Fuels)
TECK.whatTheyDo: Teck explores for, develops and produces resources, mainly copper and zinc. It has interests in mines in Canada, Chile, Peru and Alaska and a refinery in Canada, and also produces lead, silver, gold and molybdenum.

TEM.name: Tempus AI
TEM.whatTheyDo: Tempus AI sells lab tests, mainly genomic cancer and hereditary testing, and uses AI and its clinical data library to help doctors and drug companies, including through data licensing and trial matching.

TKC.name: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri
TKC.sourceName: TURKCELL ILETISIM HIZMETLERI A S annual report (20-F) (filed 2026-04-17)
TKC.whatTheyDo: Turkcell is a telecom company in Türkiye providing mobile and fixed voice and data, fiber broadband and TV, plus digital services, business technology services and financial technology services.

TME.name: Tencent Music Entertainment Group
TME.sourceName: Tencent Music Entertainment Group annual report (20-F) (filed 2026-04-17)
TME.whatTheyDo: Tencent Music runs the QQ Music, Kugou Music and Kuwo Music apps in China, selling paid memberships. It also offers karaoke via WeSing, live streaming, long-form audio via Lazy Audio, concerts and artist merchandise.

TMUS.name: T-Mobile US
TMUS.whatTheyDo: T-Mobile provides wireless phone and broadband service in the United States under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile and Mint Mobile brands. It also sells phones and other devices.

TSLA.name: Tesla, Inc.
TSLA.whatTheyDo: Tesla designs, builds, sells and leases electric cars and solar and battery storage products, generally selling direct. It offers FSD (Supervised) driver software and a Robotaxi service, and is developing Optimus robots.

TSM.name: Taiwan Semiconductor ADS
TSM.sourceName: TAIWAN SEMICONDUCTOR MANUFACTURING CO LTD annual report (20-F) (filed 2026-04-16)
TSM.whatTheyDo: TSMC is a contract chipmaker: it manufactures semiconductors designed by its customers, for uses such as AI and high-performance computing, smartphones, cars, connected devices and consumer electronics.

TYGO.name: Tigo Energy
TYGO.whatTheyDo: Tigo Energy makes hardware and software for solar power systems, mainly devices mounted under solar panels that boost output and safety, sold through distributors and installers.

UBER.name: Uber Technologies, Inc.
UBER.whatTheyDo: Uber runs apps that connect riders with drivers, and connect consumers with restaurants, grocers and stores via couriers. It also links freight shippers with carriers and operates in over 70 countries.

UI.name: Ubiquiti Inc.
UI.whatTheyDo: Ubiquiti sells networking equipment such as internet access gear, cameras and sensors, along with the UniFi and UISP software to manage them. It serves businesses and internet providers worldwide.

VFS.name: VinFast Auto Ltd.
VFS.whatTheyDo: VinFast designs and makes electric cars, mostly SUVs, along with electric scooters and buses. Based in Vietnam, it also targets markets in Asia, North America, Europe and the Middle East.

VRSN.name: Verisign Inc
VRSN.whatTheyDo: Verisign runs the registries for the .com and .net internet domains, handling their registration and lookups. It also runs two of the internet's 13 root servers and maintains the DNS root zone.

WBTN.name: Webtoon Entertainment
WBTN.whatTheyDo: WEBTOON runs a global online platform where creators publish digital comics and stories that users read, earning money from paid content, advertising and adaptations of its stories.

WM.name: Waste Management
WM.whatTheyDo: WM collects, transfers, recycles and disposes of waste in the United States and Canada, and turns landfill gas into renewable power and gas. It also offers regulated waste and secure information destruction services.

WMG.name: Warner Music Group Corp.
WMG.sourceName: Warner Music Group Corp. annual report (10-K) (filed 2025-11-20)
WMG.whatTheyDo: Warner Music Group is a music company with two businesses: recorded music, through labels such as Atlantic and Warner Records, and music publishing, which manages songwriters' songs.

WMT.name: Walmart Inc.
WMT.whatTheyDo: Walmart runs retail stores and online shopping sites and apps in 19 countries. It operates through three segments: Walmart U.S., Walmart International and Sam's Club U.S.

XXI.name: Twenty One Capital, Inc.
XXI.sourceName: Twenty One Capital, Inc. annual report (10-K) (filed 2026-03-31)
XXI.whatTheyDo: Twenty One Capital is a Bitcoin-focused company whose main assets are its Bitcoin holdings, aiming to give stock investors exposure to Bitcoin. It also plans Bitcoin education and financial services.

ZM.name: Zoom Communications, Inc.
ZM.whatTheyDo: Zoom sells communication software for businesses and individuals, including video meetings, phone, team chat, docs and whiteboard tools, plus contact center and events products.
